The '''419th Infantry''' was a military unit within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], stationed on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Established by the logistics team of the 419th, the outpost served proudly in operation against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The strike force organized from the outpost was large enough to require high levels of organization. Several officers were assigned to 419th because of their expertise with [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|scout walker]] vehicles. Many of them were also decorated for their actions in the suppression of the [[Binayre Pirates]].
